versions.changelog:
meta-ads-operator 1.0.0

- Initial release enabling end-to-end planning, creation, and editing of Meta Ads campaigns through any connected Meta Ads MCP.
- Transforms briefings into operational architectures and safely builds campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives, always starting paused.
- Enforces documentation of rationale and operational standards, including naming and tracking preservation.
- Supports capability mapping via tool discovery for maximum compatibility with different Meta Ads MCPs.
- Includes readiness validation, publishing checklists, and reference guides for robust campaign management.
